exposure: timing of ANC initiation (early vs. late)
outcome: completion of maternity continuum of care (optimal ANC, skilled birth attendants at childbirth, postnatal care utilization)
dropout from maternity continuum of care pathway (at ANC, SBA, PNC)
cohort: 21,447 pregnancies in Nigeria that resulted in births within five years prior to the 2018 Nigerian Demographic Health Survey.
finding: Only 6.5% of women completed the essential maternity continuum of care in Nigeria, with dropout being highest at postnatal care, and completion positively associated with education, wealth, women's health decision-making power, and tetanus toxoid vaccination.
cross-section timing: Data collected from births within five years preceding the 2018 Nigerian Demographic Health Survey.
